name.description: Project name; compose project and network become li-<name>

port.description: Host port bound on 127.0.0.1; auto (the default) allocates and pins a free one

persist.description: volume: named Docker volumes li-<project>-<service>-<vol> survive restarts and `down`; ephemeral: no named volumes, data is lost when the container is removed

config.description: Overrides of the definition's config values

seed.description: Seed file relative to the project root, e.g. db/seed.sql; bind-mounted read-only where the catalog's seed.mountPath says. Absolute paths and .. escapes are rejected

uses.description: Catalog id → instance name satisfying the definition's dependsOn; only needed when the stack holds several instances of that type

file.description: Env file relative to the project root, e.g. .env.local

names.description: Service instance name → variable name for its primary URL
